rules.accepted_credit_types: Board- or AAVSB RACE-approved scientific workshops/seminars; programs of AVMA/CVMA and their specialty groups, regional conferences (e.g. WVC, Central Veterinary Conference), state/provincial/local VMAs, AAHA, AVMA-accredited US/Canadian vet schools, veterinary academies; approved journals (limited); all hours may be online
rules.audit_note: Keep proof of participation at least two years; Board may inspect CE records.
rules.notes: 30 h every two years, reported with odd-year renewals; may all be online. Max 4 h journal reading, 6 h non-scientific (incl. 1 h per OVMEB public meeting attended). Also required: 1 h judicious antibiotic use (no topic code).
